name: Miron Kondratenko
original_name: マロン・コンドラチェンコ
source:
28 years old. Admiral of the Soviet Army. Mostly he is drunk, but he has an abilities and beliefs. Was in charge of Great Monster Nigayomogi. [spoiler]Though he stopped drinking for some time by the Katerina's order.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]After the Katerina's influence on him ended, he realized his homeland's problem and entered the Japanese Fleet.[/spoiler]

"Yeah, you gave me a hard time."
